content.short: Mobula provides ultra-low-latency streaming APIs for token data, prices, wallet balances and transactions across multiple chains.
content.description: Traditional data APIs are often slow to refresh and offer limited coverage. Mobula delivers ultra-fresh data with broad coverage through a streaming-first model that eliminates polling. Its APIs provide token prices, wallet balances, and transactions across multiple chains, empowering wallets, trading terminals, and developers to stay in sync with low latency and consistent, timely data. Built for scale, it enables streaming updates without polling, delivering near real-time visibility as networks expand and assets evolve.
